metadata.question: Was there more rainfall near Villarrica during January 1 and December 31, 2021 as compared to 5 years prior?

data.raw_code:
<thinking>
1. Search strategy: Use CHIRPS Daily precipitation (UCSB-CHG/CHIRPS/DAILY), compare Jan 1–Dec 31, 2021 vs Jan 1–Dec 31, 2016 near Villarrica, Chile (10 km buffer).
2. Masking strategy: Precip datasets don't need cloud masking. Use non-null counts to validate data coverage.
3. Logic: Check collection size (C1), valid pixel count after reduction (C2), and value validity (null/NaN/out-of-range => C3). Compare 2021 vs 2016 totals; if 2021 > 2016 => A else B.
</thinking>

```javascript
const ee = require('@google/earthengine');
const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7');

async function getInfo(obj) {
  return await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    obj.getInfo((v) => resolve(v), (e) => reject(e));
  });
}

function fmt(n, digits=2) {
  if (n === null || n === undefined || isNaN(n)) return String(n);
  return Number(n).toFixed(digits);
}

async function computePeriodStats(label, start, end, region) {
  const ds = 'UCSB-CHG/CHIRPS/DAILY';
  let ic = ee.ImageCollection(ds).filterDate(start, end).select('precipitation');
  let size = await getInfo(ic.size());
  if (!size || size === 0) {
    console.log(`${label} Images: 0`);
    return { status: 'C1' };
  }
  const sumImg = ic.sum();         // mm over the period per pixel
  const countImg = ic.count();     // number of valid daily pixels per pixel
  const meanTotalDict = await getInfo(sumImg.reduceRegion({
    reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(),
    geometry: region,
    scale: 5000,
    maxPixels: 1e9
  }));
  const countPxDict = await getInfo(sumImg.reduceRegion({
    reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
    geometry: region,
    scale: 5000,
    maxPixels: 1e9
  }));
  const meanDayCountDict = await getInfo(countImg.reduceRegion({
    reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(),
    geometry: region,
    scale: 5000,
    maxPixels: 1e9
  }));
  const meanTotal = meanTotalDict ? meanTotalDict['precipitation'] : null; // mm total across year (area-mean)
  const validPx = countPxDict ? countPxDict['precipitation'] : 0;          // count of non-null pixels in region
  const meanDays = meanDayCountDict ? meanDayCountDict['precipitation'] : 0;
  const coveragePct = size > 0 ? (100.0 * (meanDays || 0) / size) : 0;

  console.log(`${label} Images: ${size}, ValidPx: ${validPx}, MeanDays: ${fmt(meanDays,1)} (${fmt(coveragePct,1)}%)`);

  if (!validPx || validPx === 0) return { status: 'C2' };
  if (meanTotal === null || meanTotal === undefined || isNaN(meanTotal)) return { status: 'C3' };
  if (meanTotal < 0 || meanTotal > 10000) return { status: 'C3' }; // sanity check in mm

  console.log(`${label} Total Precip (mm): ${fmt(meanTotal,1)}`);
  return { status: 'OK', totalMm: meanTotal, images: size, validPx, coveragePct };
}

async function runAnalysis() {
  try {
    // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions (Villarrica, Chile city center; 10 km buffer)
    const villarricaPoint = ee.Geometry.Point([-72.227, -39.285]);
    const region = villarricaPoint.buffer(10000);
    console.log(`Geom: Villarrica, Chile (-39.285, -72.227), buffer=10km`);

    const p2021 = await computePeriodStats('2021', '2021-01-01', '2022-01-01', region);
    if (p2021.status !== 'OK') {
      console.log(p2021.status);
      return;
    }
    const p2016 = await computePeriodStats('2016', '2016-01-01', '2017-01-01', region);
    if (p2016.status !== 'OK') {
      console.log(p2016.status);
      return;
    }

    const diff = p2021.totalMm - p2016.totalMm;
    console.log(`Diff 2021-2016 (mm): ${fmt(diff,1)}`);

    if (p2021.totalMm === null || p2016.totalMm === null || isNaN(diff)) {
      console.log('C3');
      return;
    }
    if (p2021.totalMm > p2016.totalMm) {
      console.log('A');
    } else {
      console.log('B');
    }
  } catch (e) {
    console.log(`Error: ${e && e.message ? e.message : e}`);
    console.log('D');
  }
}

async function initEE() {
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject);
  });
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject);
  });
  await runAnalysis();
}

initEE();
```
